name: features-bento
description: Bento grid layout showcasing features in asymmetric, visually interesting cards of varying sizes

ai.whenToUse: Use when you want a modern, magazine-style feature showcase with asymmetric card sizes. Great for SaaS products, creative agencies, and tech companies that want visual variety over uniform grids.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use when features need equal visual weight or when you have fewer than 4 features. Avoid for documentation or content-heavy pages where a simple list is more appropriate.
